summary: The PR corrects a misleading hint in the error message for recursive relationships, but it does not address the underlying issue of the error itself.

issues.description: The PR only changes the hint in the error message, but it does not resolve the actual error when there are more than two ForeignKeys in an intermediary model without through_fields. This leaves users with the same incorrect guidance.
There are no tests provided to verify that the corrected hint works as intended or that the underlying error is resolved. This increases the risk of regressions in the future.
